_comment: Manifest of eval-sets published on labs.intentsolutions.io. Hand-edited for static fields (id, title, description, predicate_uri, predecessor, status). Volatile fields (version, last_changed_at) are refreshed by scripts/regenerate.py on the daily cron from upstream source.

eval_sets.title: Agent skills: the seven-check framework
eval_sets.short_description: Checks for structure, activation, task completion, repeatability and release readiness. The current Jrig command runs five checks by default; two more are opt-in. Read each run's coverage before interpreting its result.

scorecards.title: A real comparison: quick rewrite vs. structured improvement
scorecards.short_description: We gave the same rewriting task to a quick, single prompt and to our step-by-step Skill Refiner process. See both outputs, why one was chosen, what it cost, and the record behind the result.

scorecards.title: We test our own published skills
scorecards.short_description: Two AI troubleshooting guides, two different release decisions. One passed; the other was blocked after it missed a required report. The study records its checks, skipped judging and limitations alongside the results.
